description:
Dimensions (Approx.):
Number of feet to Nearest Cross Street: Approximate 53 feet from the easterly sideline of Wellington Place and 528 from the southwesterly sideline of Highway 34
Upset Bid Amount: $45,750.30
Occupancy Status: Unknown
Amount Due for Taxes: Taxes due and owing in the approximate amount of $3,643.79 as of 9/23/2024
Sale may be subject to subsequent taxes, liens, utilities and interest since 9/23/2024
Water/Sewer due and owing in the approximate amount of $249.00 as of 9/23/2024
Subject to: All unpaid municipal taxes, assessments, liens and other charges; Any set of facts which an accurate survey would disclose; Any restrictions or covenants on record which run with the land; Rights of the United States of America, if any; Any condominium lien priority pursuant to N.J.S.A. 46:88b-21(b)(1), if any; Any outstanding PUD of Homeowner’s Association dues or fees, if any; Any occupants or persons in possession of the property, if any; Additional municipal charges, liens, taxes or tax certificates and insurance, if any and any such taxes, municipal liens or other changes, liens, insurances premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to sale. The amount of unpaid taxes, municipal liens and other charges can be obtained from the local taxing authority. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation. To ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon. **If the sale is set aside for any reason, the purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The purchaser shall have no further recourse, against the mortgagee, or the mortgagee's attorney. As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Monmouth County Clerk’s Office in Instrument Number: 2004146934, et seq., New Jersey, and the writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Monmouth County.
